description: Reads the monitors of another service: UptimeRobot (a read-only API key, or its bulk upload CSV), Better Stack (a team-based API token), Uptime Kuma (its JSON backup) or a CSV file in UpHeron's format (https://upheron.com/docs/import). Creates nothing: says which would be created and which skipped and why (no UpHeron check for it, already monitored, beyond the plan's monitors, needs Pro), with the UpHeron monitor each maps to. Show the user the list before import_monitors. The key is used once and never stored. Needs a write token. Free.

api_key.description: For uptimerobot, a read-only API key (UptimeRobot: Integrations → API); for better_stack, a team-based API token (Better Stack: API tokens → Team-based tokens). Used once to list the monitors, never stored or logged.

file.description: The export file's text: a CSV for csv and uptimerobot, the backup JSON for uptime_kuma. At most 5 MB and 1,000 monitors.

source.description: Where the monitors come from: better_stack (API token), csv (UpHeron's CSV format or UptimeRobot's bulk upload template), uptime_kuma (the JSON backup of Uptime Kuma 1.x) or uptimerobot (read-only API key, or its bulk upload CSV).
